entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit customer support. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is David. How can I help you today?
Hi, David. I... I'm calling about my VeloBand Pulse. I'm just so disappointed, it's not working at all.
Oh no, I'm very sorry to hear that. I can definitely look into this for you. Could you provide me with your order number?
Yes, it's VF886-015. I've been a loyal customer for years and I saved up for this new model. It's just a shame.

I understand your frustration, and I appreciate your loyalty to VeloFit. Let me pull up that order... Okay, I see you received the VeloBand Pulse on December 15th. Can you tell me what's wrong with it? Is it a technical fault or a preference issue?
It's completely broken, I think. It tracks my steps sometimes, but it just won't sync with the app on my phone. I've tried everything. I think the device must be defective.
I see. A device that won't sync is certainly not the experience we want for our customers. I am so sorry about that. Please give me just one moment to check our return policy on this for you.
Okay... I just really hope you can help. I really needed this money if the product wasn't going to work.

Okay, I've just reviewed our policy. It looks like you are well within the 90-day return window. Since you're saying the item is defective, I can go ahead and process a full refund for you immediately. No need for any troubleshooting.
Oh, really? That's... that's such a relief. Thank you so much, David. I was so worried.

Of course. Happy to help. I've just initiated the return. I'm sending a prepaid shipping label to your email on file now. Just pack the VeloBand back in its original box, attach the label, and drop it off at any post office. Once we receive it, you'll see the refund in 3-5 business days.
That's wonderful. Thank you again for making this so easy.
You're very welcome. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's everything. Have a great day.
You too. Thanks for calling VeloFit.
